name: StarRocks
summary: Run queries over the MySQL protocol and load partitions into StarRocks with Stream Load over HTTP, labelled by partition and revision so a retry is not applied twice.

fields.name: password
fields.label: Password
fields.help: Empty only if the user has no password.

settings.name: fe_host
settings.label: Frontend host
settings.help: A frontend (FE) node; the same host serves both the MySQL port and the HTTP port.

egress.note: 9030 is the frontend MySQL port and 8030 its HTTP port. A frontend may redirect Stream Load to a backend on 8040; approve those hosts as well.

operators.summary: Run a SQL query over the MySQL protocol and keep the result as Parquet.
Send a partition's rows with Stream Load under a label from the partition and revision.

notes: Stream Load takes CSV or JSON, so Ogun converts the Parquet rows. A label can be used by one successful load in a database, which is what makes a retry safe. Ogun does not create the table.
